title: [WA] Free One-Day Bicycle, Helmet & Lock Hire (ID & $50 Refundable Bond Required) @ Fremantle Visitor Centre
body:
Deal: [WA] Free One-Day Bicycle, Helmet & Lock Hire (ID & $50 Refundable Bond Required) @ Fremantle Visitor Centre

[DH] How many bikes are going missing or I assume they would have GPS tracking?
[shoppe] Why would they go missing, or need GPS tracking? They're not even electric.
[QuickToThePointless] What happens if I ride to rotto?
$50 for a few days ‘hire’ may be the real bargain?
[OzDorgain] It would be easier to catch the boat to Rottnest, but I'd still like to see you ride a bike there 😜
[bargaino] within a 10km radius of Walyalup Koort.
for the un-woke among us, that means the square formerly known by the coloniser-oppressor name of "Kings Square". Or just "the town square".
[Joxer] No idea of that name either. Is that just the middle of Fremantle basically?
[bargaino] Yes. I had to look it up.
It's not like we have any shortage of place names here of indigenous origin.
And i'm just a bit annoyed lately by people renaming things for no good reason, be they the Orange one, or the far-left Freo council.
[fantombloo] far-left Freo council.
What are they doing that makes them far left ?
[bargaino] @fantombloo: Well, mild by overseas standards, but as far left as local politics goes here. They cancelled Australia Day.
To them, the Labor party are a bunch of fascists.
And were woke before woke was a word. made a big deal about being a "nuclear free zone" back in the 80s, while turning a blind eye to nuclear medicine at the hospital. Or isotopes in local industry.
I guess a lot of their "progressive" policies are more performative than anything else.
[chepsk8] Sweet, straight into the water she goes.
[TimOfEastBNE] I "hired" a couple of these bikes last year. They are the worst rattlers you've ever encountered. You wouldn't want to steal them. 10/10 wouldn't recommend!
